text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's charge headlong down the
Bakushin Road
this year as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit soon, but I've already written
my New
Year's resolution!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Being the model student I am, I began
writing it
within eight hours of the date
changing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!
choice_data_list: つまり起きてから書いたんだな
つまり起きてから書いたんだね
choice_data_list_en: In other words, you wrote it after you woke up.
In other words, you wrote it after you woke up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It might make you so emotional, you'll
want to
frame and display it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please, take a look! Feel free to shed
some tears
over my unwavering
aspirations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sort of knew what to expect, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's right!
choice_data_list: 『クラシックもバクシン勝利！』……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby,
the Kikuka
Sho, the Tenno Sho, as well
as the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This year I'll triumph in all these races.
I'm gonna
paint the Classics every shade
of Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I might shed tears at this rate, but for a
different
reason.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The beginning is said to be the most
crucial time
of the year! We'll start
training at once!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Go on! Exercise that trainer
authority and
tell me the first thing on
my schedule!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin toward a brighter tomorrow!
Yeah! By
which you mean to...
choice_data_list: 明日に向かってバクシンだ！
今は羽化を待つ時、休もう
choice_data_list_en: Now is the time to await your emergence. Let's rest.
What do you want to do instead?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, what do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooh! OOH!
choice_data_list: スピードで明日を捕まえるんだ
スピードで明日を捕まえるんだよ
choice_data_list_en: You've got to catch tomorrow with your speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Well certainly, it would be
possible to
transcend time with my
speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I should start running
towards the
Classics already? ...I see!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'm going to Bakushin right
at what
tomorrow brings!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following our discussion, we begin
Sakura
Bakushin O's training to increase
her speed on the
first day of the new
year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Emerge from my cocoon?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah... You couldn't mean to say you—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But... I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I trust you, Trainer. But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're my trainer after all! I'm sorry, I
don't see
you as anything more!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm destined to become a
Bakushin
butterfly, you can't just expect
to tame me once
I've emerged!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Above all, as class representative, I
could never
engage in such an impure
relationship!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It might be a good idea to put some
distance
between us for now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It is difficult to overcome feelings for
someone as
outstanding as me, I'm sure.
But... I believe in
you, so let's meet again
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as expected, the class
representative must
sometimes deliver
bad news.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Let's get you some rest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You want me to tell you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just delegating all your decision making
is not a
very admirable choice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, it was rather wise to seek the
opinion of
an outstanding class
representative like me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let me answer! What I want to do is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why the constraints?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! You want to see the wide variety
of ideas I
can come up with, right?
choice_data_list: たまにはいつもと違うことを
choice_data_list_en: How about doing something different for a change?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Allow me to answer you
once more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What I want to do besides increasing my
speed
is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: NOTHING!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let me turn this back on you! What else
is there
to life besides surpassing your
own speed?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Come on, Teach! Tell me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Afterwards, I exchange various
thoughts about
training with Sakura
Bakushin O. It seems to
contribute to her
growth.
